paragraphs.text: Okaun and Zndrsplt , known as the Eye of Chaos and Eye of Wisdom respectively, are a Cyclops and Homunculus pair from the plane of Kylem .

Okaun and Zndrsplt are partners and friends who fight together in Valor's Reach on Kylem. Okaun is a green-skinned muscular cyclops with two horns on his head, the right of which is broken near the base. Zndrsplt is a small, one-eyed, blue-skinned Homunculus who is about the size of Okaun's head. She is a former penalty mages who now rides in a basket on Okaun's shoulder and casts magic. She wears a headband with a pair of horns mirroring Okaun's. Unlike most homunculi, Zndrsplt telepathically speaks through Okaun rather than communicating through sign language.
